svg.title: Simple vs Log Returns
svg.desc: Log returns add up over time while simple returns aggregate exactly across assets, and how the two convert.
svg.text: Exact across assets, convenient across time
Near ±10% the gap is about 0.5 percentage points
The gap opens up for large moves
The red segments are the gap between the two returns
Log returns are exact when adding across time; simple returns are exact when adding across assets.
So build models in logs and report performance back in simple returns.
For small moves r ≈ R, but the approximation cannot be trusted once moves get large.
Next: normal assumption vs fat tails — stylized facts of returns.
